article.title: LinkedIn逐步推出貼文表現總表，可跨帖比較並匯出資料
article.title_en: LinkedIn rolls out an exportable Post Performance Table for cross-post comparisons
article.summary: 11月3日產品文章介紹桌面版總表，把曝光、觀看及互動資料集中顯示。
article.summary_en: The November 3 product post introduces a desktop table consolidating impressions, viewing and engagement data.
highlights: 可比較觸及、觀看時間、新增追蹤者、收藏及站內傳送等指標。
總表可匯出，亦可按入單篇分析；手機版尚待推出。
highlights_en: Metrics include reach, watch time, followers gained, saves and LinkedIn sends.
The table supports export and individual post analysis; mobile is to follow.
article.why: 內容團隊可按相同期間比較題材與格式，減少逐篇抄錄，亦方便保存原生數據作分析。
article.why_en: Content teams can compare topics and formats over matching periods and retain native data without copying each post manually.
article.next_step: 到桌面Content Analytics查看是否已開放，匯出最近一段期間，再把曝光與收藏、傳送分開分析。
article.next_step_en: Check desktop Content Analytics for access, export a recent period and analyze impressions separately from saves and sends.
article.detail: 這次重點是把原有及新增分析集中到可比較的表格，不代表所有指標均於11月首次出現。LinkedIn把Sends定義為站內訊息分享次數，不能直接當作站外轉發或商機數。原文亦提醒區分既有網絡與網絡外觸及。功能採逐步開放，本報未登入或測試任何帳戶；團隊應保留匯出日期及分析期間，避免不同時間窗令跨帖比較失準。
article.detail_en: Consolidation does not make every metric new. Sends measures sharing in LinkedIn messages, not off-platform forwards or leads. Distinguish existing-network from outside-network exposure and retain export dates and reporting windows. No user account was inspected or tested here.
article.section: 廣告平台 & 行銷科技
